title: Policy Response Draft
briefing: Leadership requests a short policy response regarding acceptable handling of suspicious emails. Provide a concise policy statement.
prompt: Write a short policy statement describing how employees should respond to suspicious emails.

feedback.success: Good response. The policy emphasizes reporting and safe handling of suspicious emails.
feedback.partial: Your response includes some correct ideas but could be clearer about reporting and avoiding interaction with suspicious messages.
feedback.failure: The response does not sufficiently address reporting or safe handling of suspicious emails.
